deficiencies.description: By changing 'this meningioma' to 'A meningioma', the rewrite broadens a specific example into a general causal claim, inaccurately implying that every meningioma puts an enormous amount of pressure on the brain.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So this meningioma obviously is occurring within the skull. The skull is a confined space. This would put an enormous amount of pressure on the brain and the surrounding structures
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A meningioma occurs within the skull, which is a confined space, so it puts an enormous amount of pressure on the brain and the surrounding structures

considerations.sourcePassage: Obviously, when there is a suspicion of cancer or of a tumor, everybody gets very nervous about what that diagnosis is going to look like.
considerations.reason: The rewrite changes this to 'there is considerable anxiety about the diagnosis', which conveys the same meaning using different words. 'Obviously' is a conversational filler appropriately omitted.

considerations.sourcePassage: because you can get benign tumors that cause death by growing and constricting on the processes of normal tissues that are adjacent to them.
considerations.reason: The rewrite drops 'on' from 'constricting on', which is a grammatical correction that maintains the exact same meaning.
